$sources: BS 5950-1:2000 Structural use of steelwork in building (Sections 3-4, Annexes B-C)
source: BS 5950-1:2000: limit state design of steel members with the design strength py (Table 9) and γm = 1.0; the generic limit state steel method of SAEngine with the BS curves (Perry-Robertson, Annex C), lateral-torsional buckling (Annex B), shear 0.6 py Av and the simplified interaction (4.8.3)

clauses.bracing: BS 5950-1:2000 4.3.2.2 (restraint force 2.5 % of the compression flange force)

sources.partialFactors: BS 5950-1:2000 2.4.4: γm = 1.0 on py (the design strengths include it); γm1 1.1 stands for the effective net area Ae = Ke An (Ke 1.2 S275, 1.1 S355, 3.4.3) with 0.9 An fu / γm1 (within 2 % of Ke An py for S275 and S355: SAEngine form); the bolt and weld factors are not used (connections from the parent pack)
sources.designStrength: BS 5950-1:2000 Table 9: py of S275 and S355 by thickness (16, 40, 63, 80, 100 mm), the flange thickness of rolled I and channel sections
sources.classification: BS 5950-1:2000 Table 11 (rolled outstands 9, 10, 15 ε; welded 8, 9, 13 ε; webs 80, 100, 120 ε at the mid-depth neutral axis, reduced by the axial force r1, r2 with the 1, 1.5, 2 factors, at least 40 ε; CHS 40, 50, 140 ε²), Table 12 (RHS flanges 28, 32, 40 ε), ε = √(275/py)
sources.compression: BS 5950-1:2000 Annex C.1-C.2: pc by Perry-Robertson, η = a (λ - λ0)/1000, λ0 = 0.2 π √(E/py), a 2.0, 3.5, 5.5, 8.0 for curves a-d; Table 23 (rolled I: about x-x a, y-y b up to 40 mm, b and c above; welded I: b and c, c and d; hot-finished hollow a; channels, angles, tees c; solid bars b taken)
sources.angles: BS 5950-1:2000 4.7.10.2: single angles with two or more bolts λ = 0.85 Lv/rv (the lower bounds 0.7 L/r + 15 and the axis rules not modelled: SAEngine form of λe; uncertain), one bolt 1.0 Lv/rv
sources.tension: BS 5950-1:2000 4.6.1 (Pt = Ae py), 4.6.3.1 (angles connected through one leg: Pt = py (Ae - 0.5 a2); SAEngine α 0.55 on An fu / γm1, uncertain)
sources.flexure: BS 5950-1:2000 4.2.5.1 (Mc = py Sx <= 1.2 py Zx; 1.5 py Zx of cantilevers), 4.2.5.3 (high shear above 0.6 Pv), Annex B.2.2 (pb by ηLT = αLT (λLT - λL0)/1000, αLT 7.0, λL0 = 0.4 π √(E/py)); λLT from Mcr of the member with the moment factor in Mcr (in place of mLT on the moment: SAEngine form); welded sections take the rolled αLT (Table 17's reduced py not modelled)
sources.shear: BS 5950-1:2000 4.2.3 (Pv = 0.6 py Av), 4.4.5 (shear buckling where d/t > 70 ε; the simple post-critical method in place of Annex H: SAEngine form, uncertain)
sources.interaction: BS 5950-1:2000 4.8.3.2 (section: Fc/(Ag py) + Mx/Mcx + My/Mcy <= 1, linear), 4.8.3.3.1 simplified (Fc/Pc + mx Mx/(py Zx) + my My/(py Zy) <= 1 and Fc/Pcy + mLT MLT/Mb + my My/(py Zy) <= 1) as the generic form with K = 1 and the moment capacities Mc (the plastic capacity in place of py Z: less conservative for class 1 and 2 sections, uncertain), m at least 0.4
sources.slenderness: BS 5950-1:2000 4.7.3.2 (180 for members resisting loads other than wind), 4.6 tension members 350 (SAEngine practice; BS 5950 has no tension limit: uncertain)
